title: Submit a run input
description: Submit a run of a runbook: its intake, its context, its settings and its confinement, into a session or alone. The run is Submitted; the runtime starts it. UNMAPPED: the client names the daemon (`daemon_id`) because a guard that reads the Daemon row through a row set cannot be synthesized (ESS-SYNTH-001: it also left every run outcome and 50 downstream outcomes without a scenario); `via` plus `predicate` can. A single daemon runs per process, so the id is a constant the implementation knows. UNMAPPED: the floor guard spells the order of the three placeholder levels out, one outcome per floor level, because ESS 0.96.0 validates `confinement_floor > input.confinement` over an ordered enum and the interpreted target then accepts every level (probed); the outcomes change with the level names. UNMAPPED: a submit with a run id that is already taken is not refused: a command keeps one `via` input in its guards (the interpreted target mis-evaluates a second, probed on 0.96.0) and the session guards use it.

sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.title: ConfinementLevel
sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.description: How strongly a run is sandboxed, weakest first. UNMAPPED: names to be aligned with the runtime; unconfined, workspace and strict are placeholders for the levels the runtime offers through Substrate. Only their order is decided: a higher level confines more.

sdc.daemon.DaemonId.title: DaemonId
sdc.daemon.DaemonId.description: The id of the one daemon the specification describes: the configuration row it holds is keyed by it.

sdc.daemon.DocumentRef.title: DocumentRef
sdc.daemon.DocumentRef.description: A reference to a document the run reads: a path inside the run's state directory, or a digest. UNMAPPED: the reference form (path, digest, URL) is not decided; the daemon keeps what the client sends.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run, chosen by the submitting client (a UUID it generated, or any unique text). The state directory of the run is named after it. UNMAPPED: the design sheet leaves open whether the client or the daemon mints the id; the client chooses here so that a retried submit names the same run and a scenario can name it. A daemon-minted id needs a typed response and `{generated: true}`. UNMAPPED: a submit with an id that is already taken is not refused in this model (see SubmitRun).

sdc.daemon.RunSettings.title: RunSettings
sdc.daemon.RunSettings.description: The settings of a run: the free map of host values (runbook run --set key=value) is every member the struct does not declare, kept as written. UNMAPPED: the typed members the runtime knows are not listed in any source read here; each is added as a declared member when the runtime names it.

sdc.daemon.RunbookId.title: RunbookId
sdc.daemon.RunbookId.description: The id of a runbook: an embedded preset such as sdc or sdc-bugfix, or a runbook run from a directory.

sdc.daemon.RunbookVersion.title: RunbookVersion
sdc.daemon.RunbookVersion.description: The version of a runbook, as runbook list shows it.

sdc.daemon.SessionId.title: SessionId
sdc.daemon.SessionId.description: The name of a session, chosen by the client that opens it.
